title: Local Serre-Pontryagin duality for a locally free sheaf on an lci projective curve over the valuation ring of a finite extension of Q_p
author: Juan Esteban Rodríguez Camargo
work: An integral model of the perfectoid modular curve
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.170
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is Proposition 3.7 at source lines 732-745, label LocalDualityCurves: for an lci projective curve f: X to Spec O_K and a locally free F of finite rank it asserts that Rf_*F is a perfect complex of length [0,1] and that cup product with the trace gives a perfect pairing from H^0(X, F tensored with K/O_K) times H^1(X, F-dual tensored with omega^circ) to K/O_K. The proof at source lines 747-763 must build the two-term free complex, replace F by F tensored with K/O_K so that the K/O coefficients compute Rf_* of (F tensored with K/O_K), and then dualize through the retained Grothendieck-Serre adjunction into R-Hom over O_K of (Rf_*F, O_K). The step that is not a routine check is the final Pontryagin-duality conversion Hom over O_K of (ker(d tensored with 1), K/O_K) = coker(d-dual) at source line 762, which is what upgrades a quasi-isomorphism of complexes into perfectness of the pairing over the non-field ring O_K. The argument is short once that conversion is seen, so the card is rated H2.
